grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: A New Skill for Li Wei
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和题目都是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思试题。请仔细阅读短文，根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题的答案必须与短文中的单词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
Li Wei is a 28-year-old office worker in Shanghai. He has worked at the same company for five years. Last year, he decided to learn English because his company started working with foreign clients. He has already taken three English courses at a language school. He has studied English since January. He has not missed a single class yet.

At first, Li Wei found English difficult. He did not understand native speakers on the phone. He felt nervous in meetings. But he has practiced speaking with a tutor every week for six months. He has also watched English movies without subtitles since March. He says, "I have improved a lot. Last month, I spoke to a client from Australia for ten minutes. I was very happy."

Li Wei's teacher, Ms. Chen, has taught English for twelve years. She says, "Li Wei has made great progress. He has already passed two online tests. He has not taken the final exam yet. But he is ready." Ms. Chen has given him extra homework since April. She has also recommended a language app. Li Wei has used it for three weeks. He likes it because he can practice anywhere.

Li Wei still makes mistakes. He sometimes forgets new words. But he has not given up. He has set a goal: he wants to give a presentation in English next year. He has not done that yet, but he is working on it. He believes that with practice, he will succeed.

questions.prompt: How long has Li Wei worked at the same company?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段明确提到“He has worked at the same company for five years.”，因此答案是“For five years”。
questions.evidence: He has worked at the same company for five years.

questions.prompt: What has Li Wei already done?
options: He has taken three English courses.
He has passed the final exam.
He has given a presentation in English.
answers: He has taken three English courses.
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“He has already taken three English courses at a language school.”，所以正确答案是“He has taken three English courses.”。其他选项在短文中没有提到或与事实相反。
questions.evidence: He has already taken three English courses at a language school.

questions.prompt: Since when has Li Wei studied English?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“He has studied English since January.”，因此答案是“Since January”。
questions.evidence: He has studied English since January.

questions.prompt: How often does Li Wei practice speaking with a tutor?
questions.explanation: 短文第二段提到“He has practiced speaking with a tutor every week for six months.”，所以频率是“Every week”。
questions.evidence: He has practiced speaking with a tutor every week for six months.

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about Li Wei's final exam?
options: He has not taken it yet.
He has not studied for it.
answers: He has not taken it yet.
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“He has not taken the final exam yet.”，因此答案是“He has not taken it yet.”。
questions.evidence: He has not taken the final exam yet.

questions.prompt: How long has Ms. Chen taught English?
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“Ms. Chen has taught English for twelve years.”，所以答案是“For twelve years”。
questions.evidence: Ms. Chen has taught English for twelve years.

questions.prompt: Li Wei has used a language app for ______ weeks. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“Li Wei has used it for three weeks.”，因此填入“three”。
questions.evidence: Li Wei has used it for three weeks.

questions.prompt: Li Wei wants to give a ______ in English next year. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 短文第四段说“he wants to give a presentation in English next year.”，所以填入“presentation”。
questions.evidence: he wants to give a presentation in English next year.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Wei has missed some English classes.
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“He has not missed a single class yet.”，这与“Li Wei has missed some English classes.”矛盾，因此是False。
questions.evidence: He has not missed a single class yet.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Wei has visited Australia.
questions.explanation: 短文提到Li Wei与一位澳大利亚客户交谈，但没有说他去过澳大利亚。文中没有提供他是否去过澳大利亚的信息，因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 文中没有提到Li Wei是否去过澳大利亚。

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者从过去开始持续到现在的动作或状态。结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还未”或“已经”；since 后接时间点，表示“自从”；for 后接时间段，表示“持续了多久”。一般过去时只表示过去发生的动作，与现在没有直接联系。
grammar.example: He has already taken three English courses at a language school.

options: She has already finished her homework.
She has already finish her homework.
She have already finished her homework.
answers: She has already finished her homework.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时的结构是 has/have + 过去分词，already 放在 has/have 之后。主语 She 是第三人称单数，用 has，动词 finish 的过去分词是 finished。因此第一句正确。
questions.evidence: She has already finished her homework.

options: I have not eaten lunch yet.
I have not eaten lunch already.
I did not eat lunch yet.
I have not ate lunch yet.
answers: I have not eaten lunch yet.
questions.explanation: yet 用于否定句，表示“还未”。现在完成时的否定形式是 have/has + not + 过去分词。eat 的过去分词是 eaten。因此第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I have not eaten lunch yet.

questions.explanation: since 后接时间点（如年份），for 后接时间段。现在完成时的结构是 has/have + 过去分词。因此第一句正确。

options: They have been married for ten years.
They have been married since ten years.
They are married for ten years.
They have married for ten years.
answers: They have been married for ten years.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段（如 ten years），表示持续了多久。现在完成时的结构是 have/has + 过去分词。因此第一句正确。
questions.evidence: They have been married for ten years.
